# How many employees does Scandit have?

Scandit AG has approximately326 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Scandit’s total headcount has declined28.8% from 457 employees in 2023 to 326 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Scandit hiring right now?

Yes, Scandit isactively hiring. Scandit had43 active job postings in 2026, a 15.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/scandit/employees#postings).

## About Scandit’s Workforce

Scandit AG is an Information Technology Services company that employs **326** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 4th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/scandit/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2009, the company is headquartered in Zuerich, Switzerland.

Scandit's workforce has declined **28.8%** from 2023 to 2026, down **7.6%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **318** in 2026 Q1 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in Western Europe ( **33.7%**), followed by Eastern Europe ( **21.9%**) and Northern Europe ( **19.4%**).

Scandit's functional groups are Finance and Operations ( **48.9%**), Engineering ( **28.1%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **23.0%**), with Sales and Marketing growing fastest (up **3.2%**). The average salary is **$118,503,** ranging from a median of **$163,000** in Western Europe to **$36,000** in Eastern Europe, up **2.5%** year over year in 2026.

Scandit's active job postings rose **15.0%** in 2026 to **43**, with new postings per month cooling from **63** in 2023 to **17** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is neutral but improving.
